parameters.query: SELECT input_usd_per_mtok, output_usd_per_mtok, cache_read_usd_per_mtok, cache_write_usd_per_mtok FROM public.lmo_model_pricing WHERE $1 LIKE model_prefix || '%' AND effective_from <= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY LENGTH(model_prefix) DESC, effective_from DESC LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO public.lmo_ledger
  (journey_id, station_id, model_requested, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, stop_reason, latency_ms, cost_estimate_usd, success, terminal_reason)
SELECT
  NULLIF(p->>'journey_id','')::uuid,
  p->>'station_id',
  p->>'model_requested',
  p->>'model',
  NULLIF(p->>'input_tokens','')::int,
  NULLIF(p->>'output_tokens','')::int,
  NULLIF(p->>'cache_read_input_tokens','')::int,
  NULLIF(p->>'cache_creation_input_tokens','')::int,
  NULLIF(p->>'stop_reason',''),
  (p->>'latency_ms')::int,
  NULLIF(p->>'cost_estimate_usd','')::numeric,
  (p->>'success')::boolean,
  NULLIF(p->>'terminal_reason','')
FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p) x
RETURNING id

parameters.content:
## Craft Call Cell (DP-CC-01)

Shared HTTP-based Anthropic caller for all AuthorsLab n8n stations.

Inputs (Execute Workflow): journey_id, station_id, model_requested, system, messages, max_tokens, cache_control?, temperature?, stop_sequences?

Contract: Every path returns either {ok:true, content, model, usage, cost} or {ok:false, terminal_reason, ...}. Non-validation exits ALWAYS write an LMO ledger row.

Laws:
- stop_reason == max_tokens is a FAIL, never a silent pass
- HTTP 4xx/5xx returns a corpse with raw error body
- Pricing lookup: no row match then cost_estimate_usd = NULL (never guessed)
- v1 has no auto-retry (Q3 approved retry deferred to v1.1 pending 429/529 ledger data)

## API + Telemetry

Raw HTTP to /v1/messages via predefined credential type (anthropicApi). fullResponse=true and neverError=true so 4xx/5xx return structurally instead of throwing. Ledger row lookup then insert on the same path for both success and failure.

## Terminal Returns

Three exits: Validation Corpse (no ledger), Success Return, Failure Corpse Return. All return uniform shape with ok boolean.
